inferred_groups.pair_rule: two buildings are linked when their centroid distance is at most group_distance_m AND the straight segment between the centroids does not cross the main-road buffer; links are then closed transitively by Union-Find (single linkage)
inferred_groups.chaining_note: single linkage means a group may contain members farther apart than group_distance_m when a chain of pairwise links connects them; see max_pairwise_source_distance_m per group

focus_group.note: the focus layout row-places only the buildings it can fit; the remaining inferred G-01 members stay at source positions, so inferred membership and focus placement are different sets

group_quality.note: descriptive group-quality metrics only: no score, no ranking and no pass/fail gate; the groups are inferred by intent.py, not designer-confirmed
